title: Virginia
description: Virginia (فيرجينيا) is an Egyptian food and oil brand. I designed its bilingual logo and packaging for its olive oil and coconut oil lines, from bottle labels to cartons and stickers.
challenge: Food packaging in local markets has to earn trust at a glance and work in two languages at once. Virginia needed a look that feels natural and quality-led, with labels that stay clear across bottles, boxes and stickers.
solution: I designed a bilingual wordmark with an olive leaf motif and built the packaging around it: olive oil bottles and cartons in deep greens, a warm treatment for coconut oil, and supporting stickers and labels, all laid out with production dielines.
results: A bilingual packaging set for Virginia: logo, olive oil bottle labels and cartons, coconut oil labels and stickers, with dielines ready for print.
